purpose: Select interpretable three/four demographic dimensions for a candidate grid, not a causal model or production Bayesian expansion.

exclude_from_stable_grid.financial_change: Current subjective state; potential reverse causality; retain for mechanism analysis.
exclude_from_stable_grid.prior_answers: Dynamic belief state, not a stable population dimension.
exclude_from_stable_grid.entry_status: Separate newcomer/returner conditioning and support audit, not an independent full cross-product here.
exclude_from_stable_grid.risk_and_financial_role: Separate behavioural/role mechanisms; questionnaire availability differs; not interchangeable with stable demographic coverage.

association: Equal-month survey-weighted Cramer V and within-month dummy-block adjusted GVIF. Descriptive, no automatic correlation cutoff.
unsupervised: Weighted MCA of complete disjunctive categorical matrix; raw inertia/scree and variable contributions are auxiliary, not outcome variance explained.

outcomes.level: Cached official Q9 mean, no refits or trimming.
outcomes.uncertainty: Cached official individual Q9 density IQR, distinct from cross-person IQR.
outcomes.reporting: Indicator of all deflation bins equal to zero among legal Q9 answers.
outcomes.distribution: Indicators Q9 mean <= -5,0,2,4,6,8,10,15,20; integrated finite-threshold CDF squared error.

feature_fit: Weighted additive dummy models with month absorption; tiny fixed numerical ridge 1e-6 times total normalized weight. No coefficient used in simulator.

development_validation.group: userid; all months share a deterministic hashed fold

temporal_identity_separation: Remove from each temporal check every respondent ID appearing in development; report excluded counts.
score: Four equally weighted domain losses relative to the no-demographic within-month reference. Monthly means removed only in evaluation; these are within-month structural scores, not national forecasting MAE.
uncertainty: 300 resamples of non-overlapping six-calendar-month development blocks; descriptive selection uncertainty, no causal or confirmatory p-values.
selection: Development only: screen >=90% mean population mass in frame cells with N>=20 and weight ESS>=10; shortlist within one bootstrap SE of best CV composite, prefer smaller Cartesian grid. If no candidate passes, report no acceptable hard grid. Temporal checks can reject stability, not trigger a new search.

planning_support.warning: Allocation/ESS projection is a planning diagnostic, not final Core count, actual draw, statistical power or independent LLM evidence.

limits: Available eight candidate traits, not all possible SCE variables.
Shared same-month public component is removed for variable selection, not predicted.
Additive screening can miss interactions; shortlisted joint-cell held-out check required.
Selection on human associations does not prove that LLM Core answers respect them.
Newcomer subpools require separate support and availability checks.
No API calls, no changes to frozen inputs or default configuration.
